# Control Star
Part of the control family Classic.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: Star
Variant: <variant name> # (required) see below for the list of variants
```

The `Variant` keyword is required and must be one of the following:
- `12Points`
- `5Points`
- `6Points`
- `8Points`

Input Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
      Default: ""
  - BorderColor: Color
      Default: App.Theme.Colors.Darker40
  - BorderStyle: Enum
      Default: BorderStyle.Solid
      Enum name: BorderStyle
      Enum values: Dashed, Dotted, None, Solid
  - BorderThickness: Number
      Default: 0
  - ContentLanguage: Text
      Default: ""
  - DisabledFill: Color
      Default: Self.Fill
  - DisplayMode: Enum
      Default: DisplayMode.Edit
      Enum name: DisplayMode
      Enum values: Disabled, Edit, View
  - Fill: Color
      Default: App.Theme.Colors.Primary
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
      Default: Self.BorderColor
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
      Default: 2
  - Height: Number
      Default: 100
  - HoverFill: Color
      Default: Self.Fill
  - OnSelect: Boolean
      Default: false
  - PressedFill: Color
      Default: Self.Fill
  - TabIndex: Number
      Default: -1
  - Tooltip: Text
      Default: ""
  - Visible: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Width: Number
      Default: 100
  - X: Number
      Default: 0
  - Y: Number
      Default: 0

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Default: AlignInContainer.SetByContainer
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
      Default: 100
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number
      Default: 100

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - AccessibleLabel: Text
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - DisabledFill: Color
  - DisplayMode: Enum
  - Fill: Color
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
  - Height: Number
  - HoverFill: Color
  - PressedFill: Color
  - TabIndex: Number
  - Tooltip: Text
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
  - X: Number
  - Y: Number
